descriptions.notStarted: I've lost the Ring I got from Moony on the way back to Gary and Shatima. Maybe Moony can help me out...
descriptions.inProgress: Moony has the Ring! I am saved. This time I should be very careful.
descriptions.completed: I got the Repaired Ring from Moony again, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!
